introHtml: Hand wash only martini glasses offer a classic, elegant look that withstands gentle care. Unlike dishwasher-safe alternatives, these glasses often feature delicate stems or thin rims that maintain clarity and brilliance. For corporate gifts, event favors, or barware promotions, they convey sophistication and attention to detail. Customize with screen-printed logos or etched designs for a premium feel your recipients will appreciate.
